scope: Aggregate input-only comparison of the 20 non-twin development movies and 175 untouched confirmation movies. No graph, ground-truth metric, score, or per-movie result was read.

result.interpretation: The narrow 20-movie development sample is not grossly shifted from the 175 confirmation movies on available image-size/intensity covariates. It is still too small to substitute for confirmation, and tail variation is materially wider in the larger cohort.

anti_adaptation: The frozen EXP192 models, parameters, cohort and promotion gates remain unchanged.
